svg.title: AHB neural network accelerator: four paths
svg.desc: The accelerator separates control, weight loading, activation input and compute/output. Control: an AHB subordinate and registers talk to a controller state machine. Weights and inputs are written over AHB, staged in an input SRAM by the controller, then sent on a shared 64-bit systolic data bus with load_weights or load_inputs and a count. Compute: an 8 by 8 systolic array with FP8 multiply and add, a partial-sum output pipeline, bias and activation, then the controller writes an output SRAM that is read over AHB.
svg.text: The weight and input paths share the 64-bit data bus. The load_weights and load_inputs signals tell the array which one is arriving.
Blue boxes mark the control point or the array end of each path.
